resources.address: 511 W 200 S Suite 140, Salt Lake City, UT 84101; 824 S 400 W Suite B134, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
resources.description: Artspace Utah and EMG Management lease affordable residential live/work apartments across Salt Lake City Artspace properties, including LIHTC units at Artspace Rubber Company and Artspace Bridge Projects.
resources.hours: Call or email to schedule a leasing appointment; some applications can be emailed, but Artspace Rubber Company and Artspace Bridge Projects applications must be completed in the leasing office.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
Affordable residential apartments and live/work housing in Artspace properties on Salt Lake City's westside and downtown area. Properties include affordable/workforce units and LIHTC units at Artspace Rubber Company and Artspace Bridge Projects.

**Eligibility Requirements**
Applicants for Artspace Rubber Company and Artspace Bridge Projects must meet LIHTC income guidelines. Artspace also performs credit, rental history, and criminal background checks for adult applicants and expects income or documentation showing how rent will be paid.

**Population Served**
Households seeking affordable apartments in Salt Lake City, including artists and creative workers. Artist or creative preference may apply, but affordable/workforce applicants do not have to earn income from art.

**How to Best Connect**
Call 801-364-1019 to schedule with the leasing office. For Artspace Rubber Company, Bridge Projects, City Center, and Macaroni Flats use 511 W. 200 S., Suite 140. For Artspace Commons and Solar Gardens use 824 S. 400 W., Suite B134.

**Important Information to Know**
Current vacancies are not guaranteed. Some properties require in-office applications, and affordability does not mean rent-free housing.
resources.name: Artspace Residential Affordable Live/Work Apartments

resources.address: 155 South 300 West, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
resources.description: Asian Association of Utah's Housing team helps individuals and families assess housing needs, plan next steps, and request available housing interventions through a public housing-assistance request form.
resources.hours: Business hours: Monday-Friday 8:30 AM-5:30 PM. AAU says a team member will reach out within two business days after the housing request form is submitted.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
Housing assessment, planning, and available housing interventions through Asian Association of Utah's Refugee Services Housing team. State TANF Family Housing materials also identify AAU as a provider for deposit, short-term rent or mortgage, utility, application-fee, back-payment, and case-management supports when TANF eligibility applies.

**Eligibility Requirements**
AAU says assistance availability changes and applicants may need Social Security cards, picture ID, birth certificates, pay stubs, and a lease agreement. TANF Family Housing support requires TANF eligibility, including a minor child in the household.

**Population Served**
Refugee and immigrant individuals and families connected to AAU services, and TANF-eligible families when TANF Family Housing funds apply.

**How to Best Connect**
Submit the Housing Assistance Request form from AAU's housing page, call 801-467-6060, or contact Housing Program Coordinator Abdi Sheikh at abdi.sheikh@aau-slc.org. The office is at 155 South 300 West in Salt Lake City.

**Important Information to Know**
Help is not guaranteed and depends on current funding, eligibility, documentation, and review by the housing team. AAU says a team member will reach out within two business days after a request is submitted.
resources.name: Asian Association of Utah Housing Assistance

resources.address: Salt Lake Valley / West Valley City shared-home locations; public address not listed
resources.description: Aspen Living Utah connects adults in Salt Lake County with shared supportive housing in residential homes, including placements that may use HRSS Waiver support.
resources.hours: Aspen Living says it responds within one business day after a referral or note; call listed partners directly for time-sensitive questions.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
Shared supportive housing for adults in the Salt Lake Valley, using real residential homes and structured living environments. Aspen Living also describes resident-rent credit reporting and coordination among property owners, care providers, case managers, families, and community partners.

**Eligibility Requirements**
The site does not publish full tenant criteria. It says HRSS Waiver is accepted and serves adults who benefit from structured living environments. Medicaid/HRSS eligibility, rent responsibility, room arrangements, and support-provider expectations should be confirmed before referral.

**Population Served**
Adults in Salt Lake County needing shared supportive housing, including people with disabilities, veterans, seniors, sober living needs, transitional living needs, reentry needs, or rapid-rehousing needs when a placement fits.

**How to Best Connect**
Use the referral form or call a partner directly: Nathan at 801-906-9973, Nam at 385-457-7753, or Long at 801-349-5035. Families, case managers, and providers can start a conversation through the site.

**Important Information to Know**
This is not a staffed shelter and may not cover ongoing rent. The site frames Aspen Living as a housing network and placement partner, so confirm current openings, house rules, rent, HRSS coverage, and whether a resident needs a care provider before proceeding.
resources.name: Aspen Living Utah Shared Supportive Housing

resources.address: 16 E Gilbride Avenue, Murray, UT 84107
resources.description: Birkhill Apartments is a Murray apartment community that advertises affordable Section 42 and market-rate apartment homes near Salt Lake City, with leasing office contact, online application, and tours.
resources.hours: Office hours: Monday-Tuesday 9:00 AM-6:00 PM; Wednesday 1:00 PM-6:00 PM; Thursday 9:00 AM-6:00 PM; Friday 1:00 PM-6:00 PM; Saturday 10:00 AM-4:00 PM; Sunday closed.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
Affordable Section 42 and market-rate apartment homes in Murray with standard apartment amenities and online application access.

**Eligibility Requirements**
Section 42 units are income-restricted; market-rate units have ordinary leasing requirements. The website does not publish full income limits, screening criteria, deposits, or fees.

**Population Served**
Renters seeking apartments in Murray or the central Salt Lake Valley, including households who may qualify for Section 42 affordable units.

**How to Best Connect**
Call 801-263-0600, use the website's Apply Online or Schedule a Tour options, or contact the leasing office at 16 E Gilbride Avenue, Murray.

**Important Information to Know**
This is not emergency housing or rent-free assistance. Verify current vacancies, whether an available unit is income-restricted or market-rate, application fees, deposits, and income limits before applying.
resources.name: Birkhill Apartments Section 42 and Market-Rate Apartment Homes

resources.description: Cherish Families provides housing navigation and stabilization support for people from polygamous families, high-control groups, or crisis situations, and is listed by Utah DWS as a statewide TANF Family Housing provider.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
Help applying for low-income or emergency housing programs, getting documents, understanding renter rights, communicating with landlords or housing workers, setting up utilities, and finding short-term rent or deposit help through partners. Utah DWS lists Cherish Families for TANF Family Housing supports including deposit assistance, short-term rent or mortgage assistance, utility assistance, application fees, back payments, and case management.

**Eligibility Requirements**
Cherish Families focuses on people from polygamous families, high-control groups, or crisis situations. TANF Family Housing assistance requires TANF eligibility, including a minor child in the household.

**Population Served**
Individuals and families leaving or affected by polygamous families, high-control groups, or crisis situations, and TANF-eligible Utah families when TANF Family Housing funds apply.

**How to Best Connect**
Call 928-875-0969 or email admin@cherishfamilies.org for TANF Family Housing access listed by DWS. The Cherish Families housing article also directs people to call, visit the website, or attend outreach events.

**Important Information to Know**
Housing help is planning and stabilization support, not guaranteed housing. TANF-funded help is limited by eligibility, documentation, and available funding.
resources.name: Cherish Families TANF Family Housing and Housing Stabilization Support

resources.address: Salt Lake City, UT 84102
resources.description: Community Housing Services, Inc. operates low-income apartment communities and provides preliminary applications for HUD-subsidized or market-rate housing, with property managers handling availability and qualification questions.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
Preliminary applications for HUD-subsidized or market-rate apartments at Community Housing Services properties. CHS operates properties for seniors, people with disabilities, families, and other income-based housing categories.

**Eligibility Requirements**
Eligibility depends on the specific property, subsidy, income rules, age or disability designation, and apartment availability. CHS says applying for HUD-subsidized housing takes time and move-in depends on availability.

**Population Served**
People seeking HUD-subsidized, income-based, senior, disability, or market-rate housing through CHS properties, including Salt Lake County properties where available.

**How to Best Connect**
Use the English or Spanish preliminary application links on the CHS Apply for Housing page, then contact the relevant property manager directly for qualification and availability questions.

**Important Information to Know**
The application page is actionable, but it is not a guarantee of an open unit. Applicants should be flexible about location and confirm the waitlist or vacancy status for each property.
resources.name: Community Housing Services HUD-Subsidized and Income-Based Apartment Applications

resources.address: 814 W 800 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84104
resources.description: Family Promise Salt Lake helps families with children experiencing homelessness request services through a public form and provides a family-specific emergency shelter and stabilization pathway.
resources.hours: Request services online anytime; call to confirm current response timing, shelter capacity, and appointment needs.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
Family homelessness services, including service-request screening, emergency shelter or shelter coordination, case management, stabilization support, and connection to community resources for families with children.

**Eligibility Requirements**
Family Promise states it can only offer support to families, defined as at least one parent and one dependent child. The public request page says rental-assistance applications are not currently being accepted.

**Population Served**
Families with at least one parent and one dependent child who are experiencing homelessness or serious housing instability in the Salt Lake area.

**How to Best Connect**
Complete the Request Services form on the Family Promise Salt Lake website or call 801-961-8622. The site says someone from the organization will contact the family after the form is submitted.

**Important Information to Know**
This is not a general adult shelter and shelter capacity is not guaranteed. The public page specifically says rental-assistance applications are not currently being accepted.
resources.name: Family Promise Salt Lake Emergency Shelter and Transitional Housing

resources.address: 720 Valdez Drive, Salt Lake City, UT 84108
resources.description: Veteran-specific transitional housing at Valor House on the Salt Lake City VA Medical Campus, with private units, meals, treatment, case management, employment/benefits navigation, and recovery support.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
Valor House provides veterans transitional housing with 72 private units with private bathrooms, shared kitchens, gym, laundry, two daily meals, therapy, substance-use treatment, medication management, intensive case management, employment and benefits navigation, legal and financial support, peer support, and a VA liaison. Program tracks include a 90-day bridge, 9-month service intensive, and 2-year clinical/special needs track.

**Eligibility Requirements**
First Step House lists eligibility as veterans of all discharge statuses who are homeless or at risk of homelessness, have no active substance use, disclose and manage psychiatric or legal issues, and have no violent convictions. Admission depends on fit, referral/admissions process, documentation, and bed availability.

**Population Served**
Veterans experiencing homelessness or at risk of homelessness who need transitional housing and integrated behavioral health or recovery support in Salt Lake County.

**How to Best Connect**
Start with First Step House Housing Admissions or call 801-359-8862. Valor House is located on the VA Medical Campus at 720 Valdez Drive, Salt Lake City. Because the housing admissions page labels this program under referrals, veterans should also ask VA homeless care coordination, a current provider, or First Step House about the current referral route.

**Important Information to Know**
This is not a walk-in emergency shelter. Admission may require referral coordination, eligibility review, and current bed availability. The direct public route is First Step House's housing admissions/front-door phone, but final entry may involve VA or provider referral.
resources.name: First Step House Valor House Veterans Transitional Housing

resources.address: 154 W 600 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
resources.description: Garden Lofts offers affordable apartments in downtown Salt Lake City, with one-, two-, and three-bedroom floor plans, leasing-team contact, tours, and an online application portal.

Affordable apartment rentals in downtown Salt Lake City, including one-, two-, and three-bedroom floor plans and an online applicant portal.

The property states income restrictions may apply. Full income limits, screening criteria, deposits, fees, and vacancy status must be confirmed with the leasing office.

Renters seeking affordable apartments in downtown Salt Lake City who can meet property income and leasing requirements.

**How to Best Connect**
Call 385-324-7218, use the Apply Now applicant portal, or schedule a tour through the Garden Lofts website. The property is at 154 W 600 S, Salt Lake City.

Affordable housing does not mean free housing. Confirm current availability, the applicable income-restricted tier, monthly rent, utilities, deposits, pet rules, and application fees before applying.
resources.name: Garden Lofts Income-Restricted Affordable Apartments

Income-restricted affordable one- and two-bedroom apartments in downtown Salt Lake City, with standard apartment amenities and leasing-office contact.

Granary Place states income restrictions apply. Candidate evidence also reported 60% AMI limits and Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher acceptance, but applicants should confirm current income limits, voucher policies, deposits, fees, and vacancies with the leasing office.

**Population Served**
Renters seeking income-qualified affordable apartments in Salt Lake City who can meet the property's income and leasing requirements.

**How to Best Connect**
Call 888-318-3557 or contact the leasing office at 258 W 700 S, Salt Lake City. Use the property's affordable housing application forms or website contact options.

This is ordinary lease-based housing with income restrictions, not rent-free assistance. Verify availability and all financial terms before applying.
resources.name: Granary Place Income-Qualified Affordable Apartments

resources.address: 1276 South 500 West, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
resources.description: Habitat for Humanity Greater Salt Lake Area's Critical Home Repair Program helps eligible low- to moderate-income homeowners with urgent repairs, including plumbing, electrical, water heater, furnace, and air-conditioning work.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**

Critical home repairs that can include plumbing and electrical hazards, roof leaks, weatherproofing, structural and safety issues, accessibility upgrades, and water heater, furnace, or A/C repairs. This category entry is most relevant when the repair restores heat, cooling, water, electricity, or another essential home utility system.

**Eligibility Requirements**

Applicant must own and occupy a home on a permanent foundation in Salt Lake, Davis, or Tooele County, meet low- to moderate-income guidelines, and meet Habitat's citizenship/legal-resident and documentation requirements. Specific repair types and project scope must be accepted by the program.

**Population Served**

Low- to moderate-income homeowners in Salt Lake, Davis, and Tooele counties who need critical repairs to remain safely housed.

**How to Best Connect**

Start the Critical Home Repair application online or call 801-263-0136 ext. 211. The main office is at 1276 South 500 West, Salt Lake City.

**Important Information to Know**

Repair assistance may include grant funding up to a stated cap plus a deferred 0% loan balance, depending on eligibility and project details. Funding availability, inspections, and the exact repair need determine whether Habitat can help.
resources.name: Habitat for Humanity Greater Salt Lake Area Critical Home Repair Program

resources.address: 428 W. 300 S., Salt Lake City, UT 84101
resources.description: A Tall Order Foundation's HomeInn program offers low-cost transitional single-room occupancy housing in the Salt Lake City area for people working toward stability after homelessness.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
Low-cost transitional housing through HomeInn single-room occupancies in the Salt Lake City area. The program describes 80 low-cost rooms, utilities included, and a bridge toward saving money and moving into more stable housing.

**Eligibility Requirements**
The site says guests must qualify for housing and follow program rules. Exact screening criteria, vacancies, identification requirements, guest policies, and move-in timing must be confirmed with the outreach office.

**Population Served**
People experiencing homelessness or major housing barriers in the Salt Lake City area who can pay program rent and participate in a self-reliance-oriented transitional housing setting.

**How to Best Connect**
Contact or visit the Homeless Outreach Office at 428 W. 300 S., Salt Lake City. Call 801-965-8628 or email atallorderfoundation@gmail.com to ask about qualifications, current openings, and the intake process.

**Important Information to Know**
This is not free emergency shelter. The official page lists entry rent at $510 per month with utilities included and says housing privileges are extended every six months as guests demonstrate ability to follow rules.
resources.name: HomeInn Transitional Housing

resources.address: 1135 East South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84102
resources.description: House of Hope's Amaryllis House is a sober living recovery housing program for women leaving residential treatment and transitioning to outpatient care, with 6-12 months of housing support and recovery services.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
Recovery housing at Amaryllis House for women leaving residential treatment and transitioning to outpatient care. The program provides sober living beds, structured housing, house rules, curfew, supportive house managers, peer support, case management, and life skills training.

**Eligibility Requirements**
Women must be in recovery and leaving residential treatment or transitioning to outpatient care. Admission requires House of Hope application or enrollment review; current bed availability and clinical requirements must be confirmed.

**Population Served**
Women in substance-use recovery who need sober living support after residential treatment in Salt Lake City.

**How to Best Connect**
Contact Heidi Lund at hlund@houseofhopeut.org, use the Amaryllis House Apply for Admission/Get Started links, or call House of Hope at 801-487-3276.

**Important Information to Know**
This is treatment-linked recovery housing, not general emergency shelter or ordinary affordable housing. The candidate also mentioned House of Hope residential treatment; that treatment housing is part of substance-use treatment and belongs primarily under addiction services.
resources.name: House of Hope Amaryllis House Recovery Housing

resources.address: 1776 S West Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84115
resources.description: The Housing Authority of Salt Lake City provides direct instructions for applying to assisted, subsidized, project-based voucher, public housing, and affordable housing waitlists serving the Salt Lake valley.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
Applications and waitlist access for assisted/subsidized housing programs, including tenant-based Housing Choice Vouchers, project-based vouchers, public housing, and non-subsidized affordable or market-rate HASLC-owned properties.

**Eligibility Requirements**
All adult household members must meet HUD and HASLC eligibility rules, including family definition, citizenship or eligible immigration status, property or program criteria, criminal and rental-history screening, any prior debt rules, and applicable income limits. Some properties have population-specific criteria such as senior or veteran status.

**Population Served**
Salt Lake City and Salt Lake valley households seeking long-term subsidized or affordable housing through HASLC.

**How to Best Connect**
Review HASLC housing options and waiting lists, apply through AffordableHousing.com when lists are open, or visit the HASLC main office at 1776 S West Temple, Salt Lake City. Call 801-487-2161 or email contact@haslcutah.org with questions.

**Important Information to Know**
This is not emergency shelter or immediate rental assistance. HASLC says waitlists are not always open and selection can take years. The tenant-based HCV waitlist is combined with Housing Connect, while some project-based or property-specific lists are HASLC-specific.
resources.name: Housing Authority of Salt Lake City Subsidized and Affordable Housing Waitlists

resources.address: 3595 South Main Street, South Salt Lake, UT 84115
resources.description: Housing Connect is Salt Lake County's housing authority, administering affordable housing properties, Housing Choice Voucher rental subsidies, public housing, project-based/RAD voucher waitlists, and supportive housing referral partnerships.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
Affordable housing properties, Housing Choice Voucher rental subsidies, public housing, Project-Based Voucher and RAD Project-Based Voucher waitlists, and supportive housing partnerships across Salt Lake County. Housing Connect's homepage listed New City Plaza and RAD Properties waiting lists open as of June 1, 2026.

**Eligibility Requirements**
Eligibility depends on the program or property. Housing Connect says households qualify based on annual gross family income and federal income-limit guidelines. Supportive housing requires partner or coordinated-entry referral; it is not a direct public application route.

**Population Served**
Low- and moderate-income households in Salt Lake County, including families, older adults, people with disabilities or chronic illness, veterans, refugees or immigrants, and people needing affordable housing when a program or property fits.

**How to Best Connect**
Check Housing Connect's homepage and Connect to Housing page for current waiting-list openings and application links, or call 801-284-4400, TDD 801-284-4407, or email info@housingconnect.org. Use AffordableHousing.com when Housing Connect directs applicants there.

**Important Information to Know**
This is not emergency housing or emergency financial assistance. Some Housing Connect pages say major HCV/PBV/RAD/Public Housing waitlists are closed, while the homepage lists selected property waitlists open; check the current page before referral. Supportive housing clients must be referred through partners such as Coordinated Entry or behavioral-health systems.
resources.name: Housing Connect Affordable Housing Waitlists and Properties

Salt Lake County funding documents describe New American Rental Assistance as tenant-based rental assistance providing short-term rental and utility assistance, housing navigation, and case management for refugee and immigrant households at risk of eviction or homelessness.

The county award describes refugee and immigrant households at risk of eviction or homelessness. Current income rules, documentation, immigration-status rules, county residency rules, and application sequence are not published on the IRC Salt Lake City public program page checked.

Refugee and immigrant households in Salt Lake County who are at risk of eviction or homelessness, if the program is currently accepting applications and the household meets program requirements.

resources.description: Journey - Center for Behavioral Health offers Housing Services that help families find and maintain housing through emergency rental assistance and other supports, with a named housing case manager contact.
resources.informationText:

Housing Services that assist families with support needed to find and maintain housing through emergency rental assistance and other services. Journey also provides targeted case management, therapy, medication assisted treatment, and employment services that may support housing stability.

The public page does not list detailed housing-service eligibility. Families in Salt Lake County needing housing stabilization support, especially families who may qualify for TANF Family Housing or Journey's behavioral-health/case-management services.

Assistance depends on eligibility, available funding, and program review. Journey's page says to contact the housing case manager for details, so confirm covered expenses, documentation, and whether treatment or case-management enrollment is required.
resources.name: Journey Center for Behavioral Health Housing Services

resources.description: Income-restricted Section 42 apartment pathway in downtown Salt Lake City with a waiting-list form, income limits, and direct application instructions.
resources.hours: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday 9 AM-5 PM; contact property before applying to ask about current availability.
resources.informationText:

Liberty CityWalk offers Section 42 income-based reduced-rent apartments. The property uses a waiting-list request form and a Section 42 rental application.

**Eligibility Requirements**
Household gross annual income must be below the property's posted maximum income limits, and each household member must meet Section 42 requirements including income, asset, and student-status verification.

**Population Served**
Households seeking income-restricted rental housing in Salt Lake City who can meet property and Section 42 screening requirements.

**How to Best Connect**
Call 844-593-2775 or use the application page to download the waiting-list request and Section 42 application. The page says to contact the property for current availability before applying and to submit completed paperwork by fax or email.

**Important Information to Know**
This is reduced-rent housing, not emergency shelter or a rent-payment program. The property says it generally works from a waiting list; applications can take days to weeks depending on verification needs.
resources.name: Liberty CityWalk Section 42 Affordable Housing

resources.address: 1031 W Center St, Suite 302, Orem, UT 84057
resources.description: TANF family housing and homeless-prevention assistance lead for families with children, including possible rent, deposit, utility, and related housing-stabilization help.
resources.hours: Office hours listed by NeighborWorks Mountain Country Home Solutions: Monday-Thursday 7:30 AM-6 PM; closed Friday-Sunday.
resources.informationText:
**Services Offered**
NeighborWorks Mountain Country Home Solutions is listed by DWS/partner sources for TANF family housing services that can help eligible families in short-term housing crises with deposits, rent, utilities, mortgage payments, back payments, and planning to stay housed.

The DWS TANF Family Housing program is for TANF-eligible families with a dependent child under age 18 and a short-term crisis. Providers must verify eligibility and may require participation with DWS employment counseling.

Families with children who meet TANF family-housing eligibility and need help stabilizing housing. Salt Lake County use should be confirmed when calling because the provider office is in Orem.

Call 801-375-5820 and ask specifically about TANF Family Housing or homeless-prevention assistance for a Salt Lake County family. The office address is 1031 W Center St, Suite 302, Orem.

This is not guaranteed rental assistance. Funding, geography, eligibility, and documentation should be confirmed before relying on it. The organization's own website confirms housing counseling and affordable-housing work; specific TANF details are supported by DWS and partner housing-resource listings.
resources.name: NeighborWorks Mountain Country Home Solutions TANF Family Housing / Homeless Prevention

resources.description: Salt Lake County nonprofit housing organization offering affordable mortgages, down-payment assistance, home-improvement loans/grants, and community land trust/homeownership pathways.

resources.informationText:

NeighborWorks Salt Lake provides housing pathways including affordable mortgages, down-payment assistance, home-improvement loans and grants, and community land trust support. Programs help with buying, keeping, repairing, or improving housing.

Eligibility varies by program, funding, city, income, property location, repayment ability, and availability. Down-payment assistance is for qualifying buyers; home-improvement funds have city and income/location rules.

Salt Lake County residents and homebuyers/homeowners who need affordable homeownership, down-payment, lending, or repair support and can meet program requirements.

Affordable rental apartments at Parker Willey, a CDCU-owned property made up of four buildings in Salt Lake City.

resources.name: Parker Willey Affordable Rental Housing

Parkgate Apartments offers rental apartments in Murray with direct leasing contact and online floor-plan/contact routes. City and affordable-housing records identify the property as low-income or income-restricted housing.

Income-restriction rules, screening criteria, deposits, fees, and availability must be confirmed directly with management. The official property page does not clearly list current affordable-housing income limits.

Renters seeking apartment housing in Murray, especially households looking for income-restricted or affordable apartment options.
